segments.environment: Physical space: Ground floor entrance lobby of Shek Tong Tsui Municipal Services Building (石塘咀市政大廈). Bright fluorescent ceiling lights and circular recessed downlights illuminate the hallway. The floor consists of light ceramic tiles covered by long maroon carpet runners and yellow tactile paving strips. Walls feature frosted glass paneling and stainless steel trim. People: A pedestrian dressed in a black t-shirt and dark trousers walks past me toward the street exit; ahead, an older man carrying a black and orange folding ladder on his shoulder walks toward the elevator hall. Objects: Automatic glass sliding doors with stainless steel vertical handles, security/reception counter on the right with a curved countertop and two CCTV monitors, yellow caution cone ('小心地滑') on the left floor, stainless steel electrical control cabinet on the left wall, and a large building directory board mounted at the corridor's end. I am carrying cardboard shipping parcels in my arms. Screen content: The reception monitors display split-view security camera feeds. Displays: The elevator hall indicator above the far right elevator shows floor 4. Text in the world: '石塘咀市政大廈 SHEK TONG TSUI MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING' above the entrance; directory board at the end of the hall. Ambient audio: Footsteps and quiet lobby ventilation noise.

screen_text.label: Claude Explanation Intro
text: 这三个词通常用来描述颗粒大小、粗细程度或精细度，常见于研磨、砂纸、滤网、咖啡研磨等场景：
screen_text.summary: Claude begins explaining that coarse, fine, and medium describe particle size or granularity in contexts like grinding, sandpaper, filters, and coffee.

screen_text.label: Claude Definition of Coarse
text: Coarse — 粗的、粗糙的。颗粒大、间距宽、质地粗。例如 "coarse salt"（粗盐）、"coarse
screen_text.summary: Claude defines 'Coarse' as rough/coarse with large particles, giving 'coarse salt' as an example.

screen_text.label: Claude Definition of Coarse (Continued)
text: Coarse — 粗的、粗糙的。颗粒大、间距宽、质地粗。例如 "coarse salt"（粗盐）、"coarse grind"（粗研磨）。
screen_text.summary: Claude provides examples of 'coarse salt' and 'coarse grind'.

screen_text.label: Claude Definitions of Medium and Fine
text: Medium — 中等的。介于粗和细之间，适中的粒度或精细度。
Fine — 细的、精细的。颗粒小、质地细腻。例如 "fine powder"（细粉）、"fine sand"（细沙）
screen_text.summary: Claude explains 'Medium' as intermediate size and 'Fine' as small particles or fine texture.

screen_text.label: Claude Application Scenarios
text: 它们经常出现在这些场景中：
• 咖啡研磨：coarse grind (法压壶用) → medium grind (手冲/滴滤用) → fine grind (意式浓缩用)
screen_text.summary: Claude illustrates the gradation from coarse grind (French press) to medium grind (drip/pour-over) to fine grind (espresso).

screen_text.label: Claude Application Scenarios (Continued)
text: • 砂纸：coarse grit（粗砂纸） → medium grit → fine grit
• 滤网/筛子：coarse mesh → medium mesh → fine mesh
• 纺织/面料：coarse fabric → fine fabric
screen_text.summary: Claude lists other domains comparing coarse, medium, and fine, such as sandpaper, mesh screens, and fabrics.

Medium — 中等的。介于粗和细之间，适中的粒度或精细度。

今天是周末，我和女朋友在深圳度过了一整天的约会时光。中午十二点左右我们在商场闲逛，随后一起去了“超能猫空间”猫咖撸猫将近一小时，我玩得特别上头，尤其喜欢德文卷毛猫的手感，还跟店里的小朋友一起逗猫“打架”。下午两点左右吃了顿水饺，席间聊起毕业设计组队的烦心事——我坚持选的AI+心理学数字孪生方向太小众，凑不齐人，但我不想换题，这关系到未来读博。饭后去GU买了条浅色牛仔裤。晚上十点多我们坐港铁从火炭回大围，路上一起刷B站美食视频、聊科研发刊和明天的安排，到家后我在电脑前安静读了一篇科普长文直到深夜。整天的主题是高质量的周末陪伴，情绪基线积极放松，学业焦虑只是偶尔浮现的暗流。

今天是周末，我和女朋友在深圳度过了一整天的约会时光。中午十二点左右我们在商场闲逛，随后一起去了“超能猫空间”猫咖撸猫将近一小时，我玩得特别上头，尤其喜欢德文卷毛猫的手感，还跟店里的小朋友一起逗猫“打架”。下午两点左右吃了顿水饺，席间聊起毕业设计组队的烦心事——我坚持选的AI+心理学数字孪生方向太小众，凑不齐人，但我不想换题，这关系到未来读博。饭后去GU买了条浅色牛仔裤。晚上十点多我们坐港铁从火炭回大围，路上一起刷B站美食视频、聊科研发刊和明天的安排，到家后我在电脑前安静读了一篇科普长文直到深夜。整天的主题是高质量的周末陪伴，情绪基线积极放松，学业焦虑只是偶尔浮现的暗流。
